caption:
Sitting too long may be linked to feeling tired even after a full night's sleep sometimes. 
   It can also be associated with headaches and muscle pain. 
   Sometimes it's the overlooked detail in our daily routine. 
   What's your daily sitting time like? 🛋️💺
comments_seeded: I never thought about how much time I spend sitting at my desk, it's probably more than I think
I've heard that taking short walks can help, but what about people who have jobs that require them to sit all day
Do you think the type of chair we sit in makes a difference, or is it just about getting up and moving regularly
I've started setting a timer to remind myself to stand up and stretch every hour, it's made a big difference for me
How do you stay active during the day when you have a job that involves a lot of sitting, do you have any tips to share? 🏋️
